title: Arrearage Management Program — Forgiveness Cap Measured per Customer
content:
# Arrearage Management Program — Forgiveness Cap Measured per Customer

**Rule.** Forgiveness under the Arrearage Management Program, the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement, is capped per customer, not per plan. The cap is the program's lifetime forgiveness cap per customer, and it is measured against the total of all forgiveness entries posted on all of the customer's Arrearage Management Program plans, across every service agreement the customer has held. The remaining room is the cap less the amount already forgiven.

1. **At enrollment.** The eligible balance placed under a new Arrearage Management Program plan may not exceed the remaining room. Any part of the past-due balance above that room stays on the service agreement, and it may be placed in a separate repayment plan only after the program plan ends.
2. **At each forgiveness.** A forgiveness that would carry the customer's total past the cap is reduced to the remaining room.
3. **Once the room is zero.** The remaining scheduled installments are billed as ordinary installments instead of being forgiven.

## Worked figures (hypothetical customer, program cap $8000.00)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Forgiven to date on two earlier program plans | $6500.00 |
| Remaining room | $8000.00 less $6500.00, that is $1500.00 |
| Past-due balance offered for a new program plan | $2300.00 |
| Balance placed under the new program plan | $1500.00 |
| Part left on the service agreement | $800.00, available for a separate repayment plan only after the program plan ends |

Later on the same plan, with $120.00 of room left, a scheduled installment of $200.00 is earned for forgiveness: $120.00 is forgiven, the room becomes zero, and every scheduled installment after it is billed as an ordinary installment.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the cap reset for a new service agreement or a new plan?** No. The measure runs over the customer's whole history across all service agreements.

**Does the cap apply to the repayment kinds?** The repayment kinds never forgive; the cap concerns Arrearage Management Program forgiveness.
